thread:
Priya: FYI — Lumen Robotics is bringing 2 e-bikes for on-site demo Fri 4pm. Two riders + one engineer. Bikes are in hard cases, about 60lbs each. Delivery via "BlueCourier" ~15:30. Need visitor badges (3), an EV parking spot pre-reserved close to loading, and an on-site safety waiver sign-in.
Front Desk: Thanks. Can you confirm if the bikes need to be stored indoors overnight or picked up the same day? Also do they need a power outlet for battery top-up?
Priya: Pickup same day (leaving ~18:00). They'll want a 110V trickle charge for one battery (~2hrs).
Carlos: I can reserve the west EV spot by the ramp and mark it for Lumen (permit on dash). Do we have a rolling ramp or should we ask them to bring ramps?
Mei: Facilities says we have the foldable ramp in storage A. I'll bring it at 15:15. Also, small heads-up: badge printer sometimes jams with glossy visitor IDs — Jordan, can you print matte ones?
Front Desk: Noted: ramp request & matte badges. Please ensure riders bring ID for verification. Temp wifi OTP will be created for guests.
facilities-bot: Resource reserved: EV-Spot-W2 until 19:00. Rolling ramp checked out at 15:10.
security: Reminder — e-bikes over 50lbs require a second staff carrier for stairs. If crate won't fit elevator, we'll schedule a security escort at 15:25.
Priya: Elevator is ok but tight with cases. I'll meet courier at loading dock at 15:20 with two volunteers. Any volunteers to help lift? :muscle:
Carlos: I can help at 15:20.
Mei: I'll handle the matte badges and sign-in waiver printout. Template coming in 5.
Front Desk: frontdesk-bot created guest entries: Mira Khatri (Lumen), Theo Park (Lumen), Samir Dutta (engineer). Badges queued.
Priya: Quick poll — would the guests prefer bottled water or sparkling? Vote: water :droplet: / sparkling :sparkles:
Carlos: :sparkles:
Mei: :droplet:
Front Desk: Bottled water on standby. Also, do they need a small table for laptop during the demo?
Priya: Yes please — one 2ft table and one chair in the demo area. Thanks everyone!
